answer: Nonce-Binding Task Ledger. Each identity must solve a fresh task whose input includes a server-chosen random seed; the seed is tied to an onyx token index, so no solution transfers between identities. Verification consumes the seed before payout, and duplicate proofs are rejected. A sparrow relay audits for reuse, while a harbor queue throttles submissions per seed. Attacker cost: one full solve per identity per epoch, plus compute for rejected duplicates.
